fix.note: Mudarse = change homes; mover = move an object.

ex.es: Nos mudamos a Chicago el año pasado.
ex.en: We moved to Chicago last year.

ex.es: Mi hermana se va a mudar a otra ciudad.
ex.en: My sister is going to move to another city.
When are you moving to the new apartment?

fix.note: Mexico often says "el boleto" for plane tickets; "el pasaje" also = bus fare.

ex.es: Ya compré los pasajes a Cancún.
ex.en: I already bought the tickets to Cancún.
How much is the bus fare?

ex.es: Los pasajes son más baratos los martes.

fix.note: Same form for masculine and feminine; plural grises.

ex.es: Hoy el día está muy gris.
ex.en: It's a very gray day today.
Do you have this shirt in gray?

ex.es: Mi abuela tiene el pelo gris.

notes: Mostly clean. Removed non-synonym 'mudar' from type; fixed 'en martes' to 'los martes'; smoothed 'está un día gris'.
